F5 on `/skills` SHALL re-render the same page (404.html redirect trick still working). 57: 58: ## 8. Run `/opsx:archive prepare-core-npm-publish` to merge the `core-npm-package` capability into main specs and move the change to `archive/`. **DO NOT run `npm publish` from within the change implementation** — that's a separate, owner-driven step performed manually after archive (and after a user-confirmed `npm pack` review). 65: 66: ## 9. Owner-driven publish (out-of-change reference) 67: 68: > The following is **not part of this change's automated work**. It is the owner's manual runbook after the change archives. Listed here for reference so the owner doesn't have to re-derive it. 69: 70: - The owner runs `cd packages/core && pnpm pack` and inspects `study-rpg-core-0.1.0.tgz` one more time. 71: - If satisfied, the owner runs `npm login` (if not already logged in) then `npm publish` from `packages/core/`. The `prepublishOnly` hook ensures fresh dist + clean typecheck. 72: - The owner pushes a git tag matching the publish: `git tag v0.1.0-core && git push origin v0.1.0-core`. 73: - A follow-up change `migrate-m2nd-to-published-core` (in the `track-m2` worktree) flips the hospital fork from `workspace:*` to `^0.1.0` once the publish is confirmed live on the registry.
